propositions: A single monolithic test loops over 884 renderable units with 1768 serial pandoc spawns, taking 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding the 300s per-test timeout on the macOS py3.13 cell
pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread kills the xdist worker process via os._exit(1) when the per-test budget is crossed, producing no traceback and no assertion text
The test cost is unbounded and load-dependent because corpus size directly inflates the loop iteration count within a single test function

Chunking the test with fixed-size parametrized batches (chunk size constant) bounds per-test cost by construction while preserving byte-identity coverage of all 884 units across the parametrized cases
A coverage guard test must verify that all parametrized chunks reassemble to the full unit set and meet the >= 100 minimum threshold from the original inline assertion
The fix spreads work across xdist workers, eliminates the 1.7x timeout overage, and adds unit-index reporting for any future byte-identity failures
